summary: First end-to-end test pass on the Foot-Care Marketplace OS. Wrote 27 pytest tests covering providers/services/availability/bookings/provider-mgmt/admin; all passed against the public preview URL. Executed Playwright flows for Client Home → Provider Profile → Book → My Bookings, Provider Dashboard (accept + earnings + save availability), and Admin (queue approve, listings, revenue). All critical flows work end-to-end.

minor.issue: Approve sets verified=true; a subsequent 'rejected' does NOT reset verified. Minor state hygiene issue — not covered by task but worth noting.

issues: The container div uses data-testid='provider-profile-time-picker' while time slot buttons use data-testid='provider-profile-time-<iso>'. A prefix selector like [data-testid^='provider-profile-time-'] matches the container too. Recommend renaming the container to 'provider-profile-time-picker-container' or similar for cleaner test targeting. Not a user-facing bug.

React hydration warning in console: <span> cannot be a child of <option> (from wrapper injected by tooling on <option> elements). Does not affect functionality, but produces a console error on the /provider route.

action_items: (Optional) Rename PROFILE.timePicker container testid to avoid prefix collision with time-slot testids.
(Optional) Reset verified=false when a previously-approved provider is set to 'rejected' in PATCH /api/admin/providers/{id}/status.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py: Blocked-date + weekly-hours validation in create_booking is duplicated with get_availability; consider a shared helper.

server.py: admin_revenue weekly bucket keys use ISO Monday derived from date-only (no tz) — consistent, but the daily bucket also derives from start_time date; if start_time tz differs across records, buckets could shift by one day.

seed.py: seed_all wipes providers/services/bookings but is only called when providers is empty at startup — so it never actually re-seeds without manual DB reset; behavior is fine but the delete_many calls are misleading dead code in that path.
seed_data_creation: Backend auto-seeded on empty DB (Maya/Jordan/Alex + Sana/Tomás + services + bookings). Tests created a TEST_ booking on Maya and toggled availability/listing/status. prov_tomas was set to approved by the admin test and then reset to pending via API.
context_for_next_testing_agent: pytest suite at /app/backend/tests/test_marketplace.py runs standalone and asserts commission math, filter matrix, all error codes (404/400/409), and admin revenue window shapes. Frontend flows are verified: booking creation requires selecting a time button whose testid begins with 'provider-profile-time-2' (not just 'provider-profile-time-') because the container div shares the prefix. After running admin tests, prov_tomas may end up approved+listing_active — reset via PATCH /api/admin/providers/prov_tomas/status {status: pending} if the pending queue count matters.
